allowed: condition_id for routing and debugging only
protocol, Hamiltonian, PF, state and component-order identity hashes
same Hamiltonian matvec callable with shape and dtype
source component spectra and coefficient sequence
same original CISD vector and normalization metadata
inherited T0, B0, t_ana, cap_active and source fallback reason
fixed candidate factors, proposed eta and numerical gates
truth-free Ritz values, lifted residuals, prefix values and local proxy observations generated in the run
action counters, wall time and memory
forbidden: exact ground state or exact ground energy
D1 weights, clusters, target identifiers or true gaps
direct PF shift or direct cost
Phase B or other direct-truth cache
required_source_checks: condition exact set equals two HF conditions
source pickle/cache hash matches source contract
current_m3 coefficient sequence and term counts match
T0, B0 and t_ana decimal and float.hex match
failure_policy: stop before any PF or H action; do not rebuild or substitute a cache
